question: Who conceptualised the idea about animal ecology in 1927?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charles Elton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Charles Elton is recognized as one of the founders of animal ecology.
 
• In 1927, he published his seminal work, "Animal Ecology," which laid the foundation for the field.
 
• Elton introduced the concept of the "ecological niche," which describes how an organism fits into its environment.
 
• He also emphasized the importance of food chains and the flow of energy through ecosystems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ecological Niche**

 
 
• An ecological niche refers to the role and position a species has in its environment.
 
• It includes all the interactions a species has with the biotic and abiotic factors of its environment.
 
 
 
• **Food Chains**
 
 
• Food chains describe the linear sequence of organisms through which nutrients and energy pass as one organism eats another.
 
• Each step in a food chain is known as a trophic level.
 
 
 
• **Energy Flow in Ecosystems**
 
 
• Energy flow refers to the movement of energy through a food chain from primary producers to various consumers.
 
• Energy decreases as it moves up trophic levels due to the second law of thermodynamics.
 
 
 
• **Charles Elton's Contributions**
 
 
• Elton's work has been fundamental in developing the field of animal ecology.
 
• His concepts have been pivotal in understanding biodiversity, conservation, and the management of natural resources.
